mapper.sql: id, user_id, permission_id, effect, data_scope_code, effective_from, effective_to, active_marker, reason, granted_by, version, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user_permission (user_id, permission_id, effect, data_scope_code, effective_from, effective_to, active_marker, reason, granted_by, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{permissionId}, #{effect}, #{dataScopeCode}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, 1, #{reason}, #{grantedBy}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_user_permission WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND permission_id = #{permissionId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_user_permission WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND permission_id = #{permissionId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_user_permission WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND active_marker=1 AND effective_from <= #{effectiveAt} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) ORDER BY permission_id
SELECT FROM t_user_permission WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND active_marker=1 AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>#{effectiveAt}) ORDER BY permission_id,id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user_permission SET effective_to=CASE WHEN effective_from>=#{effectiveTo} THEN effective_to ELSE #{effectiveTo} END, active_marker=NULL,version=version+1,update_time=#{effectiveTo} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND active_marker=1
